title: three library forms a project's own commands need (git_readonly's clearing in the current shell, the URL-owner parse, one userinfo scrubber for any text), so Laksa drops its copies
body:
## The problem

Laksa's `bin/.devbin/cmd/.lib/laksa` (Laksa commit 1224951fb) carries copies of devbin helpers because devbin lacks the form Laksa needs. Each copy's comment says it goes once devbin carries the form. Reported by laksa-dc, routed by laksa-vc, 2026-10-24.

1. **git_readonly's clearing, in the current shell.** Laksa's `laksa_git_own_repos` copies `git_readonly`'s loop that clears git's local environment variables, so a push or commit made from a hook acts on each site's own repository rather than the hook's. Its callers also call `git_readonly_prime`, so `git rev-parse --local-env-vars` runs twice per run. devbin should offer a current-shell form beside `git_readonly_prime`, reading its cache.
2. **A URL-owner parse.** `laksa_url_owner` copies `release_repo`'s HOST/OWNER/NAME parse. devbin should offer that parse as one function that `release_repo` itself calls.
3. **One scrubber for any text.** `laksa_shown` copies `release_*_shown`, which scrubs userinfo only from the URLs it is handed; Laksa needs userinfo scrubbed from any line git prints. devbin should have one scrubber that takes any text, and `release_*_shown` should call it.

(The no-prompt remote runner Laksa also copies is issue 0217.)

## Done when

1. devbin's library offers each form as one function, and devbin's own callers (`git_readonly`, `release_repo`, `release_*_shown`) are rebuilt on it, so there is one home for each (Highlander), with no behaviour change for devbin's existing callers.
2. Each new function's page or library comment says it is for a project's own commands to call.
3. Each form has an arm; the scrubber's arm covers a userinfo URL inside free text, ssh and https forms, and a line with no URL.
4. Laksa is told the release that carries them, so it drops its copies.

## Resolution

Fixed at 19d15680, on landing suite 20261024-1249 at 4c2f866f (2472 of 2472 ok, 5 environmental skips, errors seal empty; kept at ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/clone-archive/seals/land216-20261024-1249), for devbin 0.1.14, released by the cut at 593109bf (tag v0.1.14, 2026-10-24 18:42Z; its gates passed on test suite 20261024-1832, 2474 of 2474 ok, 5 environmental skips, errors seal empty). Done when 4: laksa-vc was told the tag on 2026-10-24 at 18:44Z, with each copy's replacement as listed below. cc built it in a scratch clone, and vc landed it.

Three forms in lib/helpers, each for a project's own command to call, and each the one home of what devbin's own callers do:

- **`git_local_env_clear`** clears git's repository-local variables from the current shell, reading `git_readonly_prime`'s list. `git_readonly`'s subshell runs it, with no behaviour change.
- **`url_host_path <url>`** reads a remote url as `HOST<TAB>OWNER/NAME`, with a status for each failure: no host, a second @, not OWNER/NAME. `release_repo` reads through it and keeps each refusal's words.
- **`text_shown <text>`** leaves the userinfo of every url in any text out:
  - after `://`, to the last @;
  - with no scheme, a `user:password@`;
  - a user alone is kept.
  Lines are kept, and a byte that is not UTF-8 passes through. `release_text_shown` runs its per-remote passes, then this.

**Changes, declared:**
- `release_repo` reads a no-scheme url by git's own rule: scp-like whenever no `/` comes before the first `:`. So `alias:owner/name` now resolves, where it was refused. `user:token@host/path`, git's host `user`, is refused as "is not HOST/OWNER/NAME" rather than "names no host"; its arm moves with it, and still asserts no userinfo.
- `release_repo` refuses an empty host (`file:///x/y`) as naming no host, where it told gh the repository `/x/y`.
- `release_repo` reads the host from a url's authority alone. `https://evil.example/x@github.com/o/n` named github.com's `o/n`, where its repository is on evil.example. It is now refused.
- `text_shown`'s declared limit: a password holding a raw `/`, a malformed url, is printed.
- `release_text_shown` scrubs strictly more: a credential in text belonging to no configured remote is now left out. Everything else is unchanged, and the 0188 and 0189 arms run as they were.

**For Laksa**, once a release carries this and 0217:
- `laksa_git_own_repos` becomes `git_local_env_clear`, which also ends its double prime;
- `laksa_url_owner` becomes `url_host_path`, taking the owner as the part of OWNER/NAME before its `/`, and reading "names no host" (status 2) as no owner;
- `laksa_shown` becomes `text_shown`, with Laksa joining lines itself where it prints one line;
- `laksa_remote_tip`'s runner becomes 0217's `git_remote`.
